content: The FrTSyn shall only accept an OFS message with Type equal to 0x44 and a correct CRC value if FrTSyn RxCrcValidated is configured to CRC_VALIDATED .
The FrTSyn shall only accept an OFS message with Type equal to 0x44 and a correct CRC value if FrTSyn RxCrcValidated is configured to CRC_VALIDATED .

The FrTSyn shall only accept an OFS message with Type equal to 0x44 and a correct CRC value 30 of 71 Document ID 675: AUTOSAR_SWS_TimeSyncOverFlexRay Specification of Time Synchronization over FlexRay AUTOSAR CP R21-11 if FrTSynRxCrcValidated is configured to CRC_VALIDATED .
